def: an ant (probably from its almost bisected form)

occurrences.text: Go to the ant, thou sluggard; consider her ways, and be wise:
The ants are a people not strong, yet they prepare their meat in the summer;

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
